title: status.ts header still claims /api/runs reads cloudStatusDoc
description:
The status.ts module comment says cloudStatusDoc "is still what /api/runs's own listing reads", but the composition has exactly one caller: phone.ts's overview page. /api/runs serves the raw run index and never composes a status doc, so the comment sends a maintainer hunting for a consumer that does not exist.
evidence: cloudflare/src/status.ts:20

ticfac run epic-hn6 filed this backlog tick from the finding feb0863cd804f9f44ff8cd0ab97c81a8c395f563a3620bd003d395033c2c2da8 (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-5d4/attempt-19): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/feb0863cd804f9f44ff8cd0ab97c81a8c395f563a3620bd003d395033c2c2da8.json on the run branch.
